title: How to buy and scale dealership AI
summary: Dealership AI buying guides for vendor evaluation, pricing, pilots, ROI, rollout, and scaling across stores and departments.
body_markdown:
## Buy a defined workflow, not an AI promise


A useful evaluation begins with the dealership problem, current baseline, required systems, boundaries, and success measure. Product demonstrations matter only when they exercise the dealership's real scenarios, including exceptions and failed handoffs.


Compare vendors on the same written scope. Separate subscription cost from usage, implementation, integration, support, and internal operating effort so the business case reflects the actual first year.


## Make the pilot answer a decision


A pilot should state what will be tested, which baseline will be used, who reviews quality, and what result allows the workflow to expand. Activity alone does not prove value.


Scale by proven workflow rather than activating every department at once. That keeps integration, training, policy, and measurement work proportional to verified value.
